listings.name: Wimpy False Bay Engen 1 Stop
listings.address: N2 Highway, Macassar, 7130
listings.current_description: Wimpy False Bay Engen 1 Stop is a Wimpy family restaurant at the Engen False Bay 1 Stop forecourt on the N2 in Macassar, serving breakfasts, burgers and other Wimpy menu items around the clock.

listings.name: WINK Café (Eaton Square)
listings.address: 167 Main Road, Diep River, Cape Town
listings.current_description: WINK Café (Eaton Square) is a café inside the WINK Aparthotel on Main Road, Diep River, serving breakfasts and à la carte light meals with vegetarian options, open to the public as well as hotel guests.

listings.name: Zonnebloem Boys Primary School
listings.address: 592 Cambridge Street, Zonnebloem, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Zonnebloem Boys Primary School is a public primary school in Zonnebloem on Cambridge Street, dating back to 1858 and one of the oldest schools in Cape Town, serving boys from Grade R to Grade 7.

listings.name: Arlecchino by tashas
listings.address: 16 Regent Road, Sea Point, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Arlecchino by tashas is a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant in Sea Point from the Tashas Group, with a 1970s-style interior and a menu spanning breakfast through dinner, including seafood dishes such as Bazaruto prawns and whole grilled branzino.

listings.name: Attorneys West & Rossouw
listings.address: 33 Longboat Street, Sunnydale, Noordhoek, Cape Town, 7985
listings.current_description: Attorneys West & Rossouw is a Noordhoek-based law firm of attorneys, notaries and conveyancers, with branch offices in Simon's Town, Paarl and Strand, specialising in property law, family law, estate planning and administration, and commercial law.

listings.name: Bantry Bay International Vacation Resort
listings.address: 44A Victoria Road, Bantry Bay, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Bantry Bay International Vacation Resort offers fully self-contained, serviced apartments -- from studio units to three-bedroom duplexes -- set on the rocks above the Atlantic, with a sun deck and swimming pool just above the surf.

listings.name: Bathroom Bizarre Northgate
listings.address: Cnr Platinum & Gold Street, Northgate Estate, Ysterplaat, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: Bathroom Bizarre Northgate is a showroom for bathroom fittings, tiles and plumbing supplies, part of a family-run South African sanitary ware retail chain founded in 1995, stocking vanities, taps, baths, basins, toilets and bathroom decor accessories.

listings.name: Bishopsgrace
listings.address: 5 Hillwood Avenue, Bishopscourt, Cape Town, 7708
listings.current_description: Bishopsgrace is a boutique guest house in Bishopscourt on the eastern slopes of Table Mountain, offering nine individually decorated suites, two swimming pools and a floodlit tennis court, a short walk from Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden.

listings.name: Blue Downs Clinic
listings.address: Bentley Street, Blue Downs, Cape Town, 7100
listings.current_description: Blue Downs Clinic is a City of Cape Town public health clinic on Bentley Street offering family planning, immunisation and vaccination services, HIV testing and treatment (including ARVs), and TB treatment to the Blue Downs community.

listings.name: Caroline's Health & Beauty
listings.address: Noordhoek Farm Village, Cnr Noordhoek Main Road & Village Lane, Noordhoek, Cape Town, 7979
listings.current_description: Caroline's Health & Beauty is a spa in Noordhoek Farm Village established in 2002, offering facials, body massage, manicures, pedicures, reflexology and waxing treatments in private treatment rooms, and stocking Esse and Skin Creamery skincare products.

listings.name: CityROCK
listings.address: 9 Milner St, Paarden Eiland, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: CityROCK in Paarden Eiland is the biggest indoor climbing gym in the southern hemisphere, with 2,500m2 of lead and top-rope climbing walls, a bouldering area, automatic belay walls, a gear shop and an in-house cafe.

listings.name: DC Meat
listings.address: 29452 Bravo Street, Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town
listings.current_description: DC Meat is a butchery in Beacon Valley, part of a Western Cape chain that began as a small corner butchery in Paarl in 1996 and has grown into one of the region's established meat retailers.

listings.name: Ellerman House
listings.address: 180 Kloof Road, Bantry Bay, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Ellerman House is a boutique luxury hotel set in a cliffside mansion above Bantry Bay, with individually styled rooms and suites, two villas, a spa, an adults-only sea-facing pool and a dedicated South African wine gallery.

listings.name: Espresso Lab Microroasters
listings.address: 373-375 Albert Road, Woodstock, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Espresso Lab Microroasters is a specialty coffee roastery and cafe at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, serving espresso and filter coffee sourced from traceable farms and cooperatives, alongside a range of coffee products and equipment.

listings.name: Fair Cape Factory Shop
listings.address: 11 Hunt Road, Killarney Gardens, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: Fair Cape Factory Shop is the factory outlet of Fair Cape Dairies, selling fresh milk, cheese, yoghurt and other dairy products, along with jams and confectionery, directly to the public at reduced prices, in Killarney Gardens.

listings.name: Le Bistrot de Jan
listings.address: InterContinental Table Bay, 6 West Quay Road, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Le Bistrot de Jan is a French bistro inside the InterContinental Table Bay hotel at the V&A Waterfront, serving classic bistro dishes such as steak Florentine and whole sole meuniere in a nostalgic, chandelier-lit dining room.

listings.name: Miss J'z Hair and Beauty Bar
listings.address: 5th Avenue, Lotus River
listings.current_description: Miss J'z Hair and Beauty Bar is a hair and beauty salon on 5th Avenue in Lotus River, offering hair styling and colour treatments such as Brazilian and Botox treatments alongside eyebrow, eyelash and waxing services.

listings.name: Monster Plumbing
listings.address: Unit 5, Gamib Park, 41 Stella Road, Montague Gardens, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: Monster Plumbing is a Cape Town plumbing company originally established in 1995, offering geyser installation, burst pipe repairs, bathroom and kitchen renovation plumbing, and leak detection and drain cleaning services across the greater Cape Town area.

listings.name: ORKA Paddles
listings.address: 391 Main Road, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7965
listings.current_description: ORKA Paddles is a specialist surfski and kayak paddling shop in Kirstenhof that manufactures its own paddles and also stocks Fenn kayaks and Carbonology surfskis, with an on-site Thule fitment centre for roof racks and accessories.

listings.name: Party Time Somerset West
listings.address: Unit 8, Fountain Square, 136 Main Road, Cnr Caledon St & Drama St, Somerset West, 7130
listings.current_description: Party Time Somerset West, based in Fountain Square, hires out jumping castles, waterslides, popcorn and candyfloss machines, and bubble and smoke machines and party lighting, and also stocks sweets, balloons, party packs and personalised birthday cakes.

listings.name: Pigalle Cape Town
listings.address: 57A Somerset Road, Green Point, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Pigalle Cape Town is a large restaurant and live-entertainment venue in Green Point known for fresh seafood and steak with a Portuguese-inflected menu, featuring nightly live jazz, swing and salsa performances alongside DJ sets on weekends.

listings.name: Pizza Perfect Brackenfell Corner
listings.address: Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre, Frans Conradie Drive, Brackenfell, Cape Town, 7560
listings.current_description: Pizza Perfect Brackenfell Corner is a pizzeria in Brackenfell Corner, Brackenfell, part of a franchise operating since 1989 with more than 100 stores nationwide, serving pizza, pasta, burgers and other fast food for dine-in and delivery.

listings.name: Ridgemor Villa Guest House
listings.address: R102, Firgrove, Somerset West, 7129
listings.current_description: Ridgemor Villa Guest House is an 8-room luxury guest house on a Firgrove farm dating back to 1670, one of the oldest in the area, offering en-suite rooms and a swimming pool amid the Winelands vineyards.

listings.name: Seebamboes
listings.address: 99 Harrington Street, District Six, Cape Town, 7925
listings.current_description: Seebamboes is an intimate 16-seat tasting-menu restaurant on the mezzanine level above Galjoen on Harrington Street, led by chef Adel Hughes and serving an inventive surf-and-turf menu pairing local seafood and game with seasonal Cape ingredients.

listings.name: Simunye Primary Health Care Centre
listings.address: 6 Main Road, corner Penarth Road, Three Anchor Bay, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Simunye Primary Health Care Centre is a community-oriented general practice on the Atlantic Seaboard in Three Anchor Bay, staffed by family practitioners including some with specialised experience in HIV/TB management, public health and emergency medicine.

listings.name: Somerset West Private School
listings.address: 95 Andries Pretorius Street, Audas Estate, Somerset West, 7130
listings.current_description: Somerset West Private School opened in 1998 with 8 learners and has grown to around 200 learners from pre-school to matric, offering the IEB curriculum and reporting a 100% matric pass rate for 27 consecutive years.

listings.name: South African Naval Museum
listings.address: St George's Street, Simon's Town, Cape Town, 7995
listings.current_description: The South African Naval Museum in Simon's Town displays naval uniforms, medals, ship models and a recreated submarine control room, with exhibits covering the SS Mendi tragedy and South Africa's naval history through both world wars.

listings.name: Spec-Savers Sea Point
listings.address: Shop 8, Adelphi Centre, 277 Main Road, Sea Point, Cape Town, 8005
listings.current_description: Specsavers is an optometry retailer offering eye examinations and screening for conditions such as glaucoma and cataracts alongside eyewear and hearing services at selected stores; this branch trades from Shop 8 in Adelphi Centre, Sea Point.

listings.name: Tafelberg Furnishers
listings.address: Mamacos House, 111 Main Road, Diep River, Cape Town, 7800
listings.current_description: Tafelberg Furnishers is an appliance and furniture retailer in Diep River, part of a Western Cape chain founded in the early 1960s in Bellville, stocking major appliance brands such as Smeg, AEG, Defy, Samsung and Whirlpool.

listings.name: TAH Kenridge
listings.address: 78 De Bron Avenue, Kenridge, Durbanville, Cape Town, 7550
listings.current_description: TAH Kenridge is a veterinary hospital and vetshop on De Bron Avenue in Kenridge, Durbanville, with separate dog and cat wards, an on-site laboratory and pharmacy, and a retail shop stocking pet food, treats and toys.

listings.name: Tamboers Winkel
listings.address: 3 De Lorentz Street, Gardens, Cape Town, 8001
listings.current_description: Tamboers Winkel is a coffee shop and wine bar just off Kloof Street, known for its own-blend coffee, an all-day breakfast menu, and charcuterie and cheese platters served from 4pm alongside an extensive by-the-glass wine list.

listings.name: The Cutting Room
listings.address: 8 Kommetjie Road, Fish Hoek, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: The Cutting Room is an owner-run unisex hair and image studio in Fish Hoek, established in 2005, with an adjoining clothing boutique and a small coffee shop where clients can relax with Wi-Fi while they wait.

listings.name: The Glass & Bead Cabin
listings.address: 373-375 Albert Road, Woodstock, Cape Town
listings.current_description: The Glass & Bead Cabin at The Old Biscuit Mill is a bead and glassware store in Woodstock, selling beads, glass straws and handblown glass items, with in-store glass-blowing demonstrations, custom glass trophies and jewellery repairs.

listings.name: The Milk Restaurant & Champagne Bar
listings.address: 33 Zantsi Street, corner Makabeni Road, Village 1 North, Khayelitsha, Cape Town, 7784
listings.current_description: The Milk Restaurant & Champagne Bar is a multi-storey restaurant and lounge in Khayelitsha serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, from linefish and seafood pasta to burgers and grills, alongside a rooftop Champagne Lounge for private events.

listings.name: The Shred Coffee Shop
listings.address: 68 Auckland Street, Paarden Eiland, Cape Town
listings.current_description: The Shred Coffee Shop is a retro-styled coffee shop on site at The Shred indoor skatepark in Paarden Eiland, serving pizzas, burgers, treats and coffee, with weekly burger specials, including vegan options, from Friday to Sunday.

listings.name: Tiger Wheel & Tyre
listings.address: Sun Valley Mall, Cnr Noordhoek Main Road & Buller Louw Blvd, Sunnydale, Cape Town, 7975
listings.current_description: Tiger Wheel & Tyre at Sun Valley Mall is a branch of the national tyre and vehicle-servicing chain, offering tyre sales and fitment, wheel alignment and general vehicle servicing for the Sun Valley and Noordhoek area.

listings.name: 4x4 Mega World
listings.address: 26 Marine Drive, Paarden Eiland, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: 4x4 Mega World is a specialist 4x4 and overlanding accessories store in Paarden Eiland, fitting out vehicles with gear from brands such as ARB, Old Man Emu, Engel and Alu-Cab, including winches, refrigeration units and canopy fitments.

listings.name: Agrimark Sitari
listings.address: Sitari Village Centre, Cnr R102 & Sundarbans Drive, Croydon, 7130
listings.current_description: Agrimark Sitari is a farm-and-lifestyle supply store in Sitari Village Centre, Croydon, stocking around 11,000 product lines including hardware, paint, building materials, gardening tools, pet food and braai equipment, with in-store paint mixing and delivery available.

listings.name: Bevlon Contractors
listings.address: 61 Lauda Road, Killarney Gardens, Cape Town, 7441
listings.current_description: Bevlon Contractors is a Cape Town business that has operated in the petrochemical industry for over 30 years, specialising in petroleum installations and maintenance, oil spill clean-up, and the transport of petroleum-based products, based in Killarney Gardens.

listings.name: Bradlows
listings.address: Shop 96, The Junxion Mall, Cnr Govan Mbeki & New Eisleben Roads, Philippi East, Cape Town, 7785
listings.current_description: Bradlows is a furniture and appliance retailer inside The Junxion Mall in Philippi, part of a national chain with over 120 years in South African homes, stocking pieces for the kitchen, living room, dining room and bedroom.

listings.name: Buitenverwachting
listings.address: 37 Klein Constantia Road, Constantia, 7806
listings.current_description: Buitenverwachting is a historic wine estate on Klein Constantia Road in Constantia, part of the original Constantia Estate founded by Simon van der Stel, dating back to 1773. Wine tastings are held in its historic thatched-roof cellar.

listings.name: Cape Blinds & Shutters
listings.address: Unit WS03, Epping Works, 4 Moorsom Avenue, Epping Industria 2, Cape Town, 7460
listings.current_description: Cape Blinds & Shutters supplies and installs window coverings -- including Venetian, vertical, roller and Roman blinds, plus plaswood and wooden shutters -- for homes and businesses across the greater Cape Town area, operating from Epping Industria.

listings.name: Cape Dutch Gardens
listings.address: Noordhoek Garden Emporium, Cnr Katzenellenbogen Street & Noordhoek Main Road, Noordhoek, Cape Town, 7979
listings.current_description: Cape Dutch Gardens is a nursery and garden centre in the Noordhoek Garden Emporium, stocking plants, trees, seeds, pots, irrigation supplies, garden tools, pavers and stone, with a growing focus on vegetable seedlings, herbs and soil mediums.

listings.name: Carrol Boyes (Victoria Wharf)
listings.address: Shop 6180, Ground Level, Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre, 3 Dock Rd, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town
listings.current_description: Carrol Boyes (Victoria Wharf) sells the eponymous South African brand's sculptural, functional-art homeware and gifting pieces -- pewter, aluminium and stainless-steel tableware with fluid, human-form-inspired designs -- from a label founded by artist Carrol Boyes in 1989.

listings.name: Caterware Connection
listings.address: 21 Maitland Business Park, Mowbray Road, Maitland, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: Caterware Connection, established in 2002, designs and supplies commercial catering equipment and kitchen fit-outs -- including urns, preparation tables, coffee machines, display units and refrigeration -- to restaurants, hotels and other hospitality businesses from its Maitland premises.

listings.name: Culture Wine Bar Newlands
listings.address: 1 Kildare Road, Newlands, Cape Town, 7700
listings.current_description: Culture Wine Bar Newlands is a neighbourhood wine bar and sister venue to the original Culture Wine Bar on Bree Street, offering more than 50 wines by the glass alongside tapas and cheese in a community-focused space.

listings.name: Greeff Christie's International Real Estate
listings.address: Shop 3 The Milking Shed, Noordhoek Farm Village, Noordhoek, Cape Town, 7979
listings.current_description: Greeff Christie's International Real Estate operates an estate agency office in Noordhoek Farm Village's Milking Shed, part of a Cape Town property agency founded in 2001 and affiliated with Christie's International Real Estate for global property marketing.

listings.name: Hangberg Pre-Primary School
listings.address: c/o Atlantic Skipper Street & Karbonkel Road, Hangberg, Hout Bay, Cape Town, 7806
listings.current_description: Hangberg Pre-Primary School is a pre-primary school on the grounds of Sentinel Primary School in Hangberg, Hout Bay, providing early childhood education with a daily breakfast and cooked meal, and marking a decade of operation in 2026.

listings.name: Harveys at Winchester Mansions
listings.address: 221 Beach Road, Sea Point, Cape Town, 8060
listings.current_description: Harveys is the restaurant and bar at the Winchester Mansions hotel in Sea Point, offering South African cuisine with a European twist across an indoor dining room, sea-facing terrace and courtyard, with a weekly Sunday jazz brunch.

listings.name: Ice Cape Town
listings.address: Unit 11B Marine Industrial Park, 8 Service Road, Paarden Eiland, Cape Town, 7405
listings.current_description: Ice Cape Town is a factory shop and wholesale supplier of packaged ice, craft ice and dry ice, established in 2007, also stocking gel ice packs, Buddy Cool cooler boxes and La Vie water, in Paarden Eiland.
